purpose: Teach: 左利き/つまん/シャイ/へー/かくして/戸惑っ/うっとり/噛む

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、私、左利きを矯正されたな。
lines.en: When I was young, they made me stop using my left hand.
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact opening. No bitterness — just the weight of old memory. Slow, deliberate. Lets the sentence settle.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。最近の番組、つまんないものが多いね。
lines.en: Mmm. Most of the programs these days aren't very good.
lines.style: Conversational agreement. Light, slightly amused. The casual observation of someone who's watched television for sixty years and knows the difference.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 孫、最初はシャイで、なかなか話してくれなかった。
lines.en: The grandkid was shy at first — barely said anything.
lines.style: Gentle, slightly proud undertone. Measured pace. Eyes soft with the memory of that quiet child slowly opening up.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: へー、最近は、慣れてきたわね。
lines.en: Oh — but lately they've really come around.
lines.style: Warm recognition. Small smile in the voice. The satisfaction of watching someone grow comfortable. Nodding approval without needing to say it aloud.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 長い人生、いろいろあって、かくして、今がある。
lines.en: A long life brings all sorts of things. And so, here we are.
lines.style: Philosophical but not heavy. Slow, thoughtful pacing. The tone of someone who has lived enough to know that everything connects somehow. Quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 最初の海外旅行、戸惑ったわね、二人で。
lines.en: That first trip overseas — we were so confused, weren't we, the two of us.
lines.style: Nostalgic laugh underneath. Slightly breathless at the memory. Affectionate at 「二人で」. The fondness of shared bewilderment long past.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 庭の紫陽花、うっとりするくらい綺麗だな、今年も。
lines.en: The hydrangeas in the garden are breathtaking this year too.
lines.style: Voice softens noticeably. Genuine wonder — the kind that comes from truly seeing something. Unhurried, like he's describing the color to himself. Almost tender.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 入れ歯でも、よく噛むこと、医者に言われた。
lines.en: Even with dentures, the doctor said, you have to chew well.
lines.style: Practical, slightly amused at herself. No embarrassment — just stating the fact the way you would to someone you've been married to for fifty years. Warm and matter-of-fact.
